podcast.body: He wrote this song, the lead cut from the album *Déjà Vu*, as a message to his bandmates in Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young, intending to help them navigate "loss of relationships." "The song was written by Stephen stills as a message to the band as they tried to navigate through loss of relationships."
